Request_Frontend_to_Backend.session_id: string (UUID, used to distinguish different training sessions)
Request_Frontend_to_Backend.exercise_intent: string (enum: 'squat', 'curl', used to drive high-level logic expectations)

keypoints.id: integer (0-32, corresponds to MediaPipe skeletal topology)
keypoints.z: float (depth estimation, relative to hip joint)
keypoints.visibility: float (0.0 - 1.0, confidence score; values below 0.5 should be discarded)

analysis.is_valid: boolean (whether the current pose frame is acceptable)
analysis.coaching_text: string (specific AI-generated corrective feedback for UI display)
